narr: High plains convection moved southeastward into northern Oklahoma late on the evening of the 5th into the 6th, with reports of large hail and severe wind gusts received.
ev: Road closure near 192nd and Western Ave. Up to a foot of water across the road.
lsr: ROAD CLOSURE NEAR NW 192ND AND WESTERN AVE. 6-12 INCHES OF WATER ACROSS THE ROAD.
